settings.heading: Meet Dave
settings.text:
G’day I’m Dave, as a greenskeeper with 39 years of experience, I’ve worked across a wide range of spaces, from large sports clubs to small residential lawns. In 2022, I founded My Lawn Co., an online platform aimed at helping everyone, from lawn care enthusiasts to everyday homeowners, achieve a beautiful, healthy lawn. Since then, the platform has grown quickly, building a community of people seeking expert advice and practical lawn care solutions.

Over the years, I’ve been asked countless questions about lawn care. While I had a few recommendations, I found there wasn’t a product line on the market that truly met my standards. That’s why I created My Lawn Co. Turf Care, a professional grade range designed to give you the results you’re after. I’m excited to bring a product line that combines my experience, knowledge, and commitment to helping you achieve your best lawn yet.
Founded on decades of greenskeeping experience, My Lawn Co. is growing from one breakthrough solution into a complete Turf Care Range—designed for healthier, greener lawns.
After 39 years of experience as a professional greenskeeper, working across prestigious sports clubs and residential lawns, Dave built an unmatched depth of expertise in turf management.

settings.title: 📍 2022 – The start of My Lawn Co.
settings.text: Seeing a gap in the market for real, professional advice for everyday homeowners, Dave founded My Lawn Co., an online platform dedicated to helping Australians grow healthier, greener lawns.

settings.title: 📍 2024 – Development of the Turf Care Range
settings.text: Through conversations with a growing community of lawn lovers, one thing became clear: homeowners were ready for better, more sustainable lawn solutions—solutions that didn't yet exist in the market.

settings.title: 📍 2025 – Launch of Our First Product: RESCUE Dog Wee Repair
settings.text: RESCUE became the first release in this revolutionary Turf Care line, created to fix one of the most common (and frustrating) problems facing pet owners: dog urine lawn damage.

settings.title: 📍 2026 – A New Era of Lawn Care
settings.text: What started with one breakthrough product is now growing into a broader range of professional-grade turf care solutions. With more products now available — and more still to come — My Lawn Co. is helping everyday homeowners care for every part of their lawn with confidence.
